subject.title: feat: cross-gateway sessions_send and sessions_spawn via gateway.peers

question: Should OpenClaw core accept model-facing cross-gateway session routing now, and if so must it be limited to configured peer targets instead of raw per-call gateway URLs?
rationale: The PR adds new core config and model-callable remote routing across gateway trust boundaries, while current agent-tool gateway URL overrides are deliberately allowlisted for SSRF and credential-scope hardening.

options.title: Require configured peers only
options.body: Accept the direction only if raw `gatewayUrl`/`gatewayToken` tool params are removed or routed through a maintainer-approved peer allowlist and security model.

options.title: Allow raw per-call URLs
options.body: Permit arbitrary per-call remote gateway URLs from session tools and own the broader SSRF/credential-routing surface in core.

options.title: Pause for federation design
options.body: Keep this PR open only as reference and route implementation to the broader cross-gateway federation issue before merging code.

recommendation.title: Require configured peers only
recommendation.body: Accept the direction only if raw `gatewayUrl`/`gatewayToken` tool params are removed or routed through a maintainer-approved peer allowlist and security model.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history trail for sessions_send behavior and gatewayUrl security hardening points to this owner candidate.
